critical_findings.finding: Owner and worker are replaced wholesale. Only identities, a few worker fields, changed scope/worktree and fixed-write-root key set/value inequality are constrained. Untouched owner flags and metadata are not preserved; worker/worktree and owner/worktree need not agree, source_paths and root namespaces are unbound.
demonstrated_memory_counterexamples: Owner formal_acceptance=true, formal_increment=42, parent_acceptance=true, main_adoption=true, new_external_model_call=true accepted.
Every fixed_write_roots value equal Main repository root accepted.
Worker worktree equal Main repository root and unequal owner worktree accepted.
critical_findings.inverse_does_not_detect: FULL_CANONICAL_INVERSE restores whole previous owner and worker before comparison, so arbitrary mutations within those replacement objects are erased by the inverse and pass.
critical_findings.fix: Copy old objects and allow only explicitly enumerated path/ref fields. Preserve every other key/value and key set; enforce the five new exact authorized write roots, six exact source paths, and common worktree. Bind embedded facts to the actual pinned Root scope body and its source/review/caller contracts before transaction.

additional_read_binding_observation.finding: verify(ref) returns metadata then json.loads rereads path; parsed facts and manifest membership are not necessarily the same buffer whose pin was verified. Guard later protects the expected bytes, but the transformation still uses the earlier parsed object.
additional_read_binding_observation.recommendation: Parse facts, scope and consumed manifest content from the hash/size-checked immutable byte buffer held by the read guard; keep this ordering review explicit in v2. No actual race or OS guard probe was performed.

passed_in_scope.transaction_helper_static: Exact two fixed canonical paths, expected refs checked while exclusive handles held, durable intent before writes and committed verification; no automatic inverse on partial write. This source review did not run the helper or establish fresh OS-held evidence.

limitations: Only AST-extracted transform executed in memory using current pinned baseline and clearly synthetic future facts. verify is an explicit inert stub; synthetic refs are not filesystem or authority qualification.
